name: Industrial Metal Enterprises, LLC
old_description: Let us provide you with your auger needs and screw flights using our Super Tyro AST machine utilizing Tru-Helix flight forming technology.
about:
Industrial Metal Enterprises, LLC was founded in 1993 in Blackfoot, Idaho, operating as a limited liability company serving Eastern Idaho. The business began as a metal fabrication shop and has grown into a full-service contractor for industrial, commercial, and residential clients.

The company runs a machine shop equipped with a Haas TM-2P CNC mill (40" x 16" x 16" travel, 10,000 RPM spindle) and a water jet cutter, alongside CNC plasma cutting capacity. Its signature capability is a Super Tyro AST machine with Tru-Helix flight forming technology, described as the only such machine in the western United States, used to produce custom augers and sectional screw flights. The shop fabricates structural steel, stainless steel, carbon steel, aluminum, and specialty metals into conveyors, decks, platforms, handrails, stairs, sheet metal flashings, and ornamental pieces. Welding, pipe fitting, boiler and steam fitting, and mobile welding services round out the offering. In-house design produces 3D drawings for customer approval before fabrication.

Primary markets include food processing, where sanitary design conveyors and equipment are a focus, as well as broader industrial, commercial, and residential construction across Eastern Idaho. Customers range from food plants needing auger flights and sanitary conveyors to contractors requiring structural platforms, stairs, and custom metalwork.

The firm emphasizes on-time delivery and installation, competitive pricing, and the ability to take complicated, unique designs from concept through completion. Its Tru-Helix system reduces reliance on operator expertise for consistent screw flights, and the Haas TM-2P adds high-speed machining for precision parts.
